info.name: E-Learning Platform API
info.description:
End-to-end walkthrough of every Phase 1 feature, in order. Every request has tests that check the business rule named in its title (AD-, CR-, EN-, QZ-, CC-).

All calls are `POST /api/<endpoint>` with `{ "action": "...", "data": {...} }`, except the GET routes for health, files and certificates.
Postman keeps the session cookie, so each folder signs in as the role it needs and signs out at the end.

Organisation endpoints are under /api/t/{{tenant}}/...; the super admin console is POST /api/platform.
**Before running:** start the API, run `npm run seed:superadmin` and `npm run seed:demo`, import the environment, and set superadminEmail/superadminPassword. The defaults use the demo organisations acme and globex.
**2FA:** set adminTotpSecret and teacherTotpSecret to run unattended in the Collection Runner (see TESTING.md), or paste each emailed code from the API terminal into mfaCode.

item.description: POST /api/platform. The super admin sees every organisation. Created only by `npm run seed:superadmin`.

console.log('2FA method: ' + b.mfa.method + (b.mfa.method === 'email' ? ' — copy the code printed in the API terminal into the mfaCode variable' : ''));

exec: pm.test('Lists every organisation with its counts', () => { pm.expect(b.tenants.length).to.be.above(1); pm.expect(b.tenants[0].counts).to.have.property('members'); });

pm.test('Includes {{tenant}} and {{otherTenant}}', () => { const s = b.tenants.map(t => t.slug); pm.expect(s).to.include(pm.environment.get('tenant')); pm.expect(s).to.include(pm.environment.get('otherTenant')); });
pm.test('Has its unique ID and per-organisation settings', () => { pm.expect(b.tenant.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('tenantId')); pm.expect(b.settings.quiz).to.have.property('passMark'); });
pm.test('First Admin listed with a member ID', () => pm.expect(b.admins.find(a => a.isRoot).memberCode).to.match(/^[A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]{6}$/));

item.name: Create an organisation with its first Admin

exec: pm.test('New organisation and its first Admin (invited by email)', () => { pm.expect(b.tenant.slug).to.match(/^pm-/); pm.expect(b.admin.memberCode).to.match(/-000001$/); });

Archive the test course (CR-05: enrolled courses cannot be deleted)

exec: pm.test('CR-05: delete refused, archive instead', () => pm.response.to.have.status(409));
